svg.title: How the monitor stays live
svg.desc: An open monitor owns a long-lived syncer: it prefers the server's event stream, probes the status endpoint with backoff when the stream drops, and falls back to timed rounds only when the server lacks live endpoints. Panels refresh whenever pulled data changes.

text.tspan: An open monitor owns a long-lived syncer: it prefers the server's event stream, probes the status endpoint with backoff when the stream drops, and falls back to timed rounds only when the server
